title: Voter Helpline (1950), Book-a-Call with BLO, and Grievance Redressal
summary: The National Voter Helpline 1800-11-1950 ('1950') and the Voter Helpline App provide registration, correction, roll-search, polling-station lookup, and grievance filing/tracking; 'Book-a-Call with BLO' on ECINET connects citizens directly with their Booth Level Officer; grievances are tracked via the National Grievance Service Portal (NGSP).
body:
If you are unsure who to contact or your application seems stuck:

- Call the toll-free National Voter Helpline: 1800-11-1950, 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM daily. State and District Contact Centres provide localized help.
- Use the Voter Helpline App (Android/iOS) to register, correct details, search the roll, find your polling station, look up your BLO's contact, and file/track a grievance.
- Use 'Book-a-Call with BLO' on ECINET to schedule a direct call with your Booth Level Officer.
- File a grievance through the National Grievance Service Portal; EROs/DEOs/CEOs are directed to resolve requests within 48 hours where feasible.
- Email complaints@eci.gov.in for written complaints/feedback.

VoteAssist India will always point users to these official channels rather than attempting to resolve application status itself, since it does not have access to ECI's internal systems.
